record_id.description: Stable UUID5 from manufacturer, exact model and variant; retain ID through renames.

name.description: Display label; manufacturer, model and variant.

manufacturer.description: Product brand or system supplier as cited; does not imply cell manufacture.

model.description: Exact source product name or model code, preserving case and punctuation.

variant.description: Explicit region, revision, configuration or rating distinguishing this row.

product_family.description: Source-reported family when an exact model code is available.

capacity_scope.description: Physical unit described: cabinet, enclosure, string or configured system; not project capacity.

market_scope.description: Explicit region/market for this variant; unknown is null.

chemistry.description: Source-reported battery chemistry; not inferred from supplier.

cell_manufacturer.description: Named cell OEM only when explicitly sourced for this product.

form_factor.description: Source enclosure or assembly format; e.g. 20-foot container.

document_revision.description: Revision/date printed on the principal specification; not the retrieval date.

power_conditions.description: Source test/temperature conditions and derating for power.

energy_conditions.description: Energy measurement conditions, including BOL/FAT when stated.

efficiency_conditions.description: RTE test conditions and exclusions; do not assume auxiliaries included.

cycle_life_conditions.description: Cycle-life test conditions and end-of-life threshold; not a warranty.

warranty_conditions.description: Contractual conditions; design life is not warranty.

derating_notes.description: Ambient temperature, altitude and other source-reported derating conditions.

ingress_protection.description: Scope-specific enclosure IP rating; not pack IP substituted for enclosure.

fire_protection.description: Source-described safety equipment; not independent safety verification.

notes.description: Editorial interpretation, uncertainty, exclusions and limitations.

record_scope.description: A documented configuration or configurable product family; never a fabricated option combination.

architecture.description: Product boundary; PCS integration only when explicitly stated.

product_status.description: Document classification, not confirmation of current commercial availability.

quality_status.description: Evidence status; manufacturer claims are not independently validated performance.

power_rating_kind.description: Whether the power value is rated, maximum or unspecified.

energy_basis.description: Meaning of energy_capacity_mwh; unknown basis must be explicit.

energy_boundary.description: Electrical boundary for the energy rating.

efficiency_qualifier.description: Qualifier attached to the RTE; preserve upper/lower bounds.

energy_capacity_mwh.description: Documented single-configuration energy; family ranges belong in extensions.

power_capacity_mw.description: Reported active power only; never apparent power or an E/P-derived estimate.

apparent_power_mva.description: Reported apparent AC power, separate from active MW.

duration_hours.description: Source-reported duration, never inferred from mixed-basis E/P.

ac_voltage_v.description: Single reported nominal AC voltage; alternatives remain in extensions.

round_trip_efficiency_pct.description: Manufacturer-reported RTE; boundary, qualifier and conditions are mandatory.

cycle_life.description: Source-reported cycle life; requires test conditions.

design_life_years.description: Source-reported design life; does not imply warranty.

warranty_years.description: Warranty term only when explicitly stated with conditions.

width_m.description: Unit width as defined in the cited document.

depth_m.description: Unit depth as defined in the cited document.

height_m.description: Unit height as defined in the cited document.

weight_kg.description: Unqualified/rated unit mass; maximum mass uses weight_max_kg.

weight_max_kg.description: Documented upper mass bound; strict/approximate qualifier retained in extensions.

altitude_max_m.description: Reported altitude limit; derating conditions must remain attached.

operating_temperature_min_c.description: Minimum ambient operating temperature; not internal cell temperature.

operating_temperature_max_c.description: Maximum ambient operating temperature; preserve derating.

pcs_included.description: Integrated PCS explicitly present or excluded.

source_urls.description: Derived sorted unique source URLs; never manually inferred.

field_sources_json.description: Per-field source-ID lists; wildcard attribution is forbidden.

compliance_claims_json.description: Manufacturer claims with status/scope; test methods such as UL 9540A are not product certifications.

extensions_json.description: Namespaced optional specifications, bounds and configuration ranges.

conflicts_json.description: Conflicting source assertions with evidence; requires needs_review.

created_at.description: UTC date of database record creation, not product launch.

updated_at.description: UTC date of last substantive record change.

last_verified_at.description: UTC source-check date; not physical validation or proof of availability.
